name: Product close-up with the USB digital microscope
description: Switch the microscope's LED ring on at a non-saturating level, run a single-shot autofocus, photograph the vial on the balance with the overhead webcam, take two close-ups of the product with the USB digital microscope (Sanwa Supply 400-CAM106 = Vitiny UM22, or any UVC microscope), switch the LED off again and send Robot 1 home. The shared-device steps carry no robot_id and the devices are opened only because they appear in the flow. Camera indices and the microscope's control port come from config.yaml (shared_devices.camera_index / microscope_index / microscope_port) or from --camera-index / --microscope-index / --microscope-port. The lens position after focusing is written to the focus_position column of measurements.csv; to reproduce a focus, replace the autofocus step by {"action": "microscope_focus", "mode": "position", "position": <recorded value>}. Without a microscope_port the microscope_led / microscope_focus steps fail before anything moves; remove them if your microscope has no serial control.
